**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The termination package sits at the **preferred** position:

- **Customer convenience right** — § 9.4 lets Customer terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause; § 29.4 sets that notice at **thirty days**, matching the preferred 30-day standard.
- **No penalty** — Customer owes "only accrued Fees," and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by § 10.2). The 15% liquidated damages in § 7.7 attach to late payment, not termination, so they are out of scope for this rule.
- **No Vendor convenience exit** — Vendor's termination rights are confined to material breach (§ 9.1), insolvency (§ 9.2), and the narrow IP-remedy carve-out in § 20 (which expressly bars terminating unaffected Services). § 24.4 also blocks a change-of-control exit.

This holds across the three-year term in § 8.1, so no deviation arises.
